dialogues.jp: 「ただいま」
dialogues.en:
Nemu looks up happily as she writes something with the TV
on.
dialogues.text:
Nemu looks up happily as she writes something with the TV
on.

dialogues.jp:
テレビをつけながら、なにか書き物をしていた
音夢が嬉しそうに顔を上げる。
dialogues.en: Why does she always look so happy?
dialogues.text: Why does she always look so happy?

dialogues.jp: なんでいつも楽しそうなんだこいつ。
dialogues.en: "What are you writing? Is it an embarrassing poem?"
dialogues.text: "What are you writing? Is it an embarrassing poem?"

dialogues.jp: 「なに書いてるんだ？　恥ずかしいポエムか？」
dialogues.en:
When Nemu opens her notebook, it could be a diary,poem,
household account book, or homework.
dialogues.text:
When Nemu opens her notebook, it could be a diary,poem,
household account book, or homework.

dialogues.jp:
日記、ポエム、家計簿、宿題などなど――音夢
がノートを広げていても中身の幅は広い。
dialogues.en:
This time, I guessed poem because of the way she looked so
happy, since it's her dream to be a poet in a future.
dialogues.text:
This time, I guessed poem because of the way she looked so
happy, since it's her dream to be a poet in a future.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「違います。ぶ・ん・つ・う」
dialogues.en: "You're wrong. It's a letter."
dialogues.text: "You're wrong. It's a letter."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「文通？」
dialogues.en: "A letter?"
dialogues.text: "A letter?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「文通というのは、あの、絶対に長続きするこ
　とのない文通のことだよな」
dialogues.en:
"You mean, as in a correspondence which never last for long.
That kind of letter?"
dialogues.text:
"You mean, as in a correspondence which never last for long.
That kind of letter?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「兄さんのような筆不精には、という前置きを
　しておいてください……ん、んん〜」
dialogues.en:
"You have to say 'for a poor correspondent like me' if you
say that."
dialogues.text:
"You have to say 'for a poor correspondent like me' if you
say that."

dialogues.jp:
広げていた便箋をノートと一緒に閉じて、音夢
が背伸びをする。
dialogues.en: She hid her letter inside a book and stretched.
dialogues.text: She hid her letter inside a book and stretched.

dialogues.jp: 「疲れてそうだな」
dialogues.en: "You look tired."
dialogues.text: "You look tired."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「はえ？」
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「いや、夜は勉強とかもしてるんだろうから、
　あまり無理はするなよ」
dialogues.en:
"Well, you should take it easy, since you're studying at
night and stuff."
dialogues.text:
"Well, you should take it easy, since you're studying at
night and stuff."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「分かってますよ。そんな心配しなくても大丈
　夫ですぅ」
dialogues.en: "I know that. You don't have to worry like that."
dialogues.text: "I know that. You don't have to worry like that."

dialogues.jp: 全然大丈夫じゃないから心配してるんだけどな。
dialogues.en: I'm worried because she doesn't seem to understand that.
dialogues.text: I'm worried because she doesn't seem to understand that.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「まっ、最近はちょっと身体がだるい感じがす
　るけどね……あ〜、いたたたた」
dialogues.en:
"Although I have been feeling a bit tired lately. Ouch, it
hurts..."
dialogues.text:
"Although I have been feeling a bit tired lately. Ouch, it
hurts..."

dialogues.jp: 首を左右に揺らして肩を掴む音夢。
dialogues.en:
Nemu moved her neck from right to left, and grabbed her
shoulder.
dialogues.text:
Nemu moved her neck from right to left, and grabbed her
shoulder.

dialogues.jp:
こんなおっさん臭い行動を見せられたら、学園
の連中で卒倒する奴が出るんじゃないか……。
dialogues.en:
I'm sure if one of the guys at school saw her acting like a
middle-aged man, he would faint.
dialogues.text:
I'm sure if one of the guys at school saw her acting like a
middle-aged man, he would faint.

dialogues.jp: 「ふむ」
dialogues.en: "Huh."
dialogues.text: "Huh."

dialogues.jp:
鞄を床において、上着のボタンをはずしながら
音夢の背後に忍び寄る。
dialogues.en:
I put my bag on the floor and sneaked behind Nemu as I
unbuttoned my shirt.
dialogues.text:
I put my bag on the floor and sneaked behind Nemu as I
unbuttoned my shirt.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ふん、ふふ〜ん♪」
dialogues.en: "Mm, Mmm..."
dialogues.text: "Mm, Mmm..."

dialogues.jp:
目標はこちらの動きに気づかず、リモコンを手
にテレビにくぎ付けになっていた。
dialogues.en:
The target didn't notice my move while she concentrated on
the TV with a remote control in her hand.
dialogues.text:
The target didn't notice my move while she concentrated on
the TV with a remote control in her hand.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "What!?"
dialogues.text: "What!?"

dialogues.jp:
俺が音夢の肩に触れると、ビクッと面白いくら
い震えた。
dialogues.en: Nemu shook in surprise.
dialogues.text: Nemu shook in surprise.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ちょ……ちょっと兄さん？」
dialogues.en: "Don't raise your voice..."
dialogues.text: "Don't raise your voice..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「大人しくしろ」
dialogues.en: I whispered in her ears, as I loomed over her from behind.
dialogues.text: I whispered in her ears, as I loomed over her from behind.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「大人しくって……ふぁぅ」
dialogues.en: "Hey! Niisan! Don't be silly!"
dialogues.text: "Hey! Niisan! Don't be silly!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「に、兄さん！　だ、駄目だよ。私、肩は弱い
　んだから」
dialogues.en: "Quiet!"
dialogues.text: "Quiet!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「気にするな」
dialogues.en: "No! Stop, stop. I give up!"
dialogues.text: "No! Stop, stop. I give up!"

dialogues.jp:
最初は少し揉んだら止めるつもりだったのだが
……。
dialogues.en:
Nemu curled her body up trying to escape, but she didn't
mean it for real.
dialogues.text:
Nemu curled her body up trying to escape, but she didn't
mean it for real.

dialogues.jp: 音夢の奴、見た目以上に肩がこってるぞ。
dialogues.en: "But, it's so stiff. This must feel good, doesn't it?"
dialogues.text: "But, it's so stiff. This must feel good, doesn't it?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さん……」
dialogues.en: "Don't say that. Ah!"
dialogues.text: "Don't say that. Ah!"

dialogues.jp:
目の前にある音夢の頭を掴んで後ろに倒すと、
俺は音夢のおでこに自分のおでこをくっつけた。
dialogues.en: "Do you like it, here?"
dialogues.text: "Do you like it, here?"

dialogues.jp: 「ふむ。別に熱はないようだな」
dialogues.en: I applied more pressure, moving my fingertips a little.
dialogues.text: I applied more pressure, moving my fingertips a little.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ありません！　というか、いきなりこんなこ
　とするのやめてください！」
dialogues.en: "Oh, that hurtd... Stop it..."
dialogues.text: "Oh, that hurtd... Stop it..."

dialogues.jp: 音夢が俺のおでこを払って、頭を戻す。
dialogues.en: "See? You're breathing hard."
dialogues.text: "See? You're breathing hard."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「もうっ、兄さんったら、デリカシーの｛かけら／欠片｝も
　ないんだからっ」
dialogues.en: "So are you..."
dialogues.text: "So are you..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「なに怒ってるんだよ？」
dialogues.en:
Nemu put her little white sweaty hand over mine, as I put it
where she likes it.
dialogues.text:
Nemu put her little white sweaty hand over mine, as I put it
where she likes it.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「知りません！」
dialogues.en:
"You're breathing hard and your heart's pounding hard...
Ah!"
dialogues.text:
"You're breathing hard and your heart's pounding hard...
Ah!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「訳の分からない奴だな」
dialogues.en: "Don't move around like that. Be still."
dialogues.text: "Don't move around like that. Be still."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ほら、いつまでも肩を怒らせてたら肩が揉め
　ないだろう。もっとリラックスしろよ」
dialogues.en: "Mm... Ah... Haah, haah..."
dialogues.text: "Mm... Ah... Haah, haah..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「……もう、兄さんが余計なことするからこう
　なったんじゃない」
dialogues.en: "Do you like this area, where the dip is?"
dialogues.text: "Do you like this area, where the dip is?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「はいはい」
dialogues.en: "Ouch... a little bit less... Mm... like that."
dialogues.text: "Ouch... a little bit less... Mm... like that."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「もうっ」
dialogues.en:
Nemu sank into the sofa, not being able to take too much
pleasure.
dialogues.text:
Nemu sank into the sofa, not being able to take too much
pleasure.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そんなにモーモー言ってたら、牛になるぞ」
dialogues.en: I massaged her body, bending forward to follow her body.
dialogues.text: I massaged her body, bending forward to follow her body.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「なりません！」
dialogues.en: "Ah, right there. Oh, no! That's so good."
dialogues.text: "Ah, right there. Oh, no! That's so good."

dialogues.jp: 肩の力を抜いた音夢がしみじみと呟く。
dialogues.en: "Don't make it sound like that!"
dialogues.text: "Don't make it sound like that!"

dialogues.jp:
「……だから俺がこうして揉んでやってるんじゃ
　ないか」
dialogues.en: I slapped her head.
dialogues.text: I slapped her head.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Ouch!? What are you doing?"
dialogues.text: "Ouch!? What are you doing?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さん、今なんて……」
dialogues.en:
"I'm just massaging your neck! What kind of reaction's
that!?"
dialogues.text:
"I'm just massaging your neck! What kind of reaction's
that!?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「べ、別に、俺は何も言ってないぞ？」
dialogues.en:
"Who cares! You have to consider the fact that my neck's
very sensitive!"
dialogues.text:
"Who cares! You have to consider the fact that my neck's
very sensitive!"

dialogues.jp:
思わず口走ってしまったのが聞こえてしまった
らしい。
dialogues.en: "It's my fault?"
dialogues.text: "It's my fault?"

dialogues.jp: 「ど、どうやらもうこってないみたいだな」
dialogues.en: I looked up to the ceiling, smoothing my heated neck.
dialogues.text: I looked up to the ceiling, smoothing my heated neck.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「…………兄さんったら、ほんとに素直じゃな
　いんだから」
dialogues.en: "I, I'll be going to my room."
dialogues.text: "I, I'll be going to my room."

dialogues.jp:
何だか急に居心地が悪くなって、音夢に背中を
向けた。
dialogues.en:
She straightened her shirt, and said it with a straight
face.
dialogues.text:
She straightened her shirt, and said it with a straight
face.

dialogues.jp:
このまま居間に居続けるのは、俺の精神衛生上
良くないような気がする。
dialogues.en: "Fine, but you're in a weird mood."
dialogues.text: "Fine, but you're in a weird mood."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さん！」
dialogues.en: "Right... well."
dialogues.text: "Right... well."

dialogues.jp: 背中を向けた俺に、音夢の声が届く。
dialogues.en:
Nemu tilted her head and looked at me shyly as she turned
around.
dialogues.text:
Nemu tilted her head and looked at me shyly as she turned
around.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ありがとう」
dialogues.en: "That felt good."
dialogues.text: "That felt good."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ありがとうって、言ったの」
dialogues.en: "It felt good, so can you do that again?"
dialogues.text: "It felt good, so can you do that again?"

dialogues.jp: 振り返ると、音夢が目線を逸らしてそう言った。
dialogues.en: Nemu mumbled as she looked away.
dialogues.text: Nemu mumbled as she looked away.

dialogues.jp: 「お、おう」
dialogues.en: "S-Sure."
dialogues.text: "S-Sure."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「う、うん」
dialogues.en: "Okay."
dialogues.text: "Okay."

dialogues.jp: お互いに手を軽く上げて別れる。
dialogues.en: We raised our hands up in the air and parted.
dialogues.text: We raised our hands up in the air and parted.

dialogues.jp: 「ふぅ」
dialogues.en: "Well..."
dialogues.text: "Well..."

dialogues.jp: 居間を出ると俺は思いっきり深呼吸をした。
dialogues.en: I sat down on the warm sofa where Nemu was sitting just now.
dialogues.text: I sat down on the warm sofa where Nemu was sitting just now.

dialogues.jp: なんだか妙に肩がこっていた。
dialogues.en: My neck was stiff.
dialogues.text: My neck was stiff.

dialogues.jp: ◆肩こり音夢さん◆
dialogues.en: ◆An erotic massage◆
dialogues.text: ◆An erotic massage◆

dialogues.jp:
学園から帰ってくると、居間で音夢が文通相手
に、手紙を書いていた。
dialogues.en:
Nemu was writing a letter in the living room. Her neck was
very stiff, so I came behind her to give her a neck massage.
dialogues.text:
Nemu was writing a letter in the living room. Her neck was
very stiff, so I came behind her to give her a neck massage.

dialogues.jp: コキコキ肩を鳴らす音夢。
dialogues.en: Nemu moaned in an erotic way, which made me hot.
dialogues.text: Nemu moaned in an erotic way, which made me hot.

dialogues.jp: たまには揉んでやるか。
dialogues.en: "I'm home."
dialogues.text: "I'm home."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、見た目以上にこっている音夢の肩を揉ん
でやるのだった。
dialogues.en: "Oh, welcome back!"
dialogues.text: "Oh, welcome back!"
